findings.current: For that callow brat, who’d only passed twenty two years ago, the realm of the Three Flowers Gather at the Crown was nothing more than a step on the way to a greater height.
findings.defect: The Korean says Taekyung had only passed the age of twenty two years earlier. This wording omits the age he passed and can instead suggest he passed twenty-two years ago.
findings.rationale: 약관 is the age of twenty; 이 년 전에야 약관을 넘긴 means he crossed that age only two years ago.
findings.replacement: For that callow brat, who’d only come of age two years ago, the realm of the Three Flowers Gather at the Crown was nothing more than a step on the way to a greater height.

findings.current: The Fire King, Jeok Cheongang, and the Thunderbolt Saber King, Peng Cheolhu, looked at each other and chuckled.
findings.defect: The source calls the two men 거인, “giants,” an image omitted from the assembled copy.
findings.rationale: 두 거인은 explicitly characterizes them as giants before describing their shared laugh.
findings.replacement: The two giants, the Fire King Jeok Cheongang and the Thunderbolt Saber King Peng Cheolhu, looked at each other and chuckled.

findings.current: “Now, now. Is that any way to speak to your younger brother? It seems Jeok hyung still hasn’t come to his senses.”
findings.defect: The line drops the specific joke: Cheolhu objects that Jeok Cheongang is still addressing his younger brother as “you bastard” (네놈), rather than merely speaking disrespectfully in general.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly contrasts the new sibling relationship with Jeok Cheongang’s continued use of 네놈, preserving the playful complaint about his form of address.
findings.replacement: “Now, now. You’re calling your younger brother ‘you bastard’? It seems Jeok hyung still hasn’t come to his senses.”

findings.current: This time, the Thunderbolt Saber King laughed aloud. His face, covered in fine wrinkles and age spots after he’d given away everything he had, creased deeply.
findings.defect: “Given away” implies Cheolhu transferred his possessions or power to someone. The source says he emptied himself of everything he had.
findings.rationale: 자신이 가진 모든 것을 남김없이 비워 낸 뒤 describes complete depletion, not giving things away.
findings.replacement: This time, the Thunderbolt Saber King laughed aloud. After emptying himself of everything he had, his face, covered in fine wrinkles and age spots, creased deeply.

summary: The assembled copy has a few source-fidelity losses: it blurs Taekyung’s age, weakens a specific joke about forms of address, and implies Cheolhu gave his strength away. It also omits the source’s image of the two men as giants.
